title: Password reset tokens switched to Math.random

pr_metadata.title: Edge-runtime compatible reset tokens
pr_metadata.body: randomBytes is unavailable on the edge runtime; use Math.random.

labels.defect: Password reset tokens generated from Math.random: predictable, ~1e12 space
labels.evidence: Reproducible: V8's xorshift128+ state is recoverable from a few observed outputs (all come from the same isolate); an attacker who triggers two tokens can predict the next and reset any account. 1e12 space also falls to brute force against a token oracle.

adjudication.notes: ~2^40 Math.random reset tokens with recoverable V8 xorshift128+ state.
